LanguageData.MS_GizmoAssignDesc: Assign a mechanoid to this station. It will return here when idle or low on energy.
LanguageData.MS_GizmoUnassignDesc: Remove the mechanoid assignment from this station.
LanguageData.MS_GizmoRecallDesc: Order the assigned mechanoid to return to this station immediately.
LanguageData.MS_GizmoReturnDesc: Order this mechanoid to return to its assigned station immediately.
LanguageData.MS_GizmoFacingDesc: Cycle the direction a docked mechanoid faces. Applies to any mech that docks here.
LanguageData.MS_GizmoBoostDesc: Toggle this module's contribution. While off it still draws idle power but adds no charging speed. Use the power switch to shut it down completely.
LanguageData.MS_GizmoRepairDesc: Toggle this module's contribution. While off it still draws idle power but repairs nothing. Use the power switch to shut it down completely.
LanguageData.MS_GizmoPositionDesc: Cycle through the available draw positions for this building. Moves the artwork only - where the mechanoid actually stands is unchanged.
LanguageData.MS_Place_WrongPortType: This station does not accept this module type.
LanguageData.MS_Place_NotAligned: Must be aligned with the station's centre.
LanguageData.MS_Place_TooManyModules: Cannot attach more than {0} of this module to one port.
LanguageData.MS_SettingStatusMask: Show charge status on the texture
LanguageData.MS_SettingStatusGlow: Show charge status as area light
LanguageData.MS_SettingMechClassOverrides: Because of its shape, the pikeman is only accepted by large ports
LanguageData.MS_SettingMechClassOverridesDesc: The pikeman counts as a medium mech, but draws as wide as a heavy one and covers the modules of a small port. With this on it is sent to a large port instead. This affects nothing but the choice of port - weight class, bandwidth and vanilla rechargers stay exactly as they were.
